title: euodia grisea
intro: Euodia grisea, commonly known as Chinese prickly ash, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family, native to China. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, respiratory problems, and fever reduction. The therapeutic actions of Euodia grisea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Euodia grisea include coumarins, limonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
